_text: [urgent, building] Ten steps. Twenty. THIRTY. Your stick stands in dry sand. [quick, excited] You see, the moon held the ocean up in a bump, like a hand lifting a *bedsheet*. [amused] Let go, and the sheet doesn't *slam*. It just... settles. [deadpan] No wave. Just a slow, boring *tide*. [amused] When your lantern burns down, the water crawls back... and quits a third of the way to your *stick*. [dramatic] But the moon was the world's biggest nightlight. Without it, the night goes a hundred times *darker*. [amused] So Brad's floodlights are the brightest thing for fifty miles, and every moth for fifty miles finds BRAD. [amazed] Up there, nobody sees a thing. But on your dark beach, the sky *explodes* with stars. [proud] So four-thousand people carry a lawn chair DOWN to the ocean, straight to Grandma's popcorn.
